Summary

A senior operator-builder who embeds with the client and ships GenAI into their environment, from discovery through production handoff, in domains where getting it wrong is expensive. I have been the sole product-and-technology partner inside a $350M-ARR healthcare client, and I build the systems myself: ARCS is an LLM-native decision platform on Claude with a custom MCP server, agentic orchestration, retrieval, and human-in-the-loop control by design. That work has consistently been in regulated, clinical, and life-sciences-adjacent settings: HIPAA digital therapeutics, rare-disease research operations, SEC/FINRA. In those rooms I speak the commercial model and the stakeholder goals, not just the stack. I stay hands-on, and I bring junior engineers up behind me.
